name: Kolkata
desc: Families and professionals in Kolkata, West Bengal trust Insurance Support for transparent, independent insurance advisory. From policy selection to complex claim recoveries, our IRDAI-certified experts provide dedicated doorstep service.
it_focus: Group health, personal accident, and portable term insurance for IT employees in Salt Lake Sector V and New Town action area.
senior_focus: Doorstep LIC maturity claim and pension support for established families in Ballygunge, Behala, and Tollygunge.
branch_dets: Direct liaison with LIC zonal office at Mint Street and BBD Bagh, plus private insurer offices in Park Street.

local_faqs.question: Which are the top cashless hospitals in Kolkata for health insurance?
local_faqs.answer: Kolkata Medical College, AMRI Hospitals, Apollo Gleneagles, Woodlands Hospital, and Fortis Kolkata are in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Can you assist with insurance ombudsman complaints in Kolkata?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we prepare documentation and represent grievances at the Insurance Ombudsman office in Kolkata for health and life insurance claim disputes.
